title: THE UNDERCROFT PAUSE BOX LISTS THE FLOOR PAD BUTTONS
why: Found by the code review of 2026-10-08: with a pad, the pause box in the Undercroft listed the raid layout (A dodge roll, X reload, RT fire), but on the floor A works a station, X, Y and RB are its other actions, and LS click jogs, so nearly every line contradicted the pad in hand. On the floor the box now lists the floor buttons; in a raid it lists the raid ones as before.
now: Pausing in the Undercroft on a controller shows the Undercroft controller buttons.
